purpose: Evaluate original native positions and explicit value bindings on new licensed article families.
Evaluate reviewed Word comment copies and PDF annotation copies separately from parser accuracy.

selection.ordering: Sort the bounded metadata response by publication date then DOI. Select the first two eligible families; retain each inspected eligibility or transport failure.
selection.eligibility: Published research article with a CC-BY-4.0 original PDF. PLOS strata also require an original DOCX table supplement; exclude checklist, questionnaire, search strategy, quality assessment, primer, antibody and protocol captions before content inspection.
selection.failure_rule: Do not replace selected files after layout access or parser outcomes. Record unavailable or empty inputs and unfilled target slots.
selection.access_rule: Filter source responses to bibliographic/licensing and download-link fields. Do not expose article bodies, abstract results, original DOCX text or PDF pages from held-out families until implementation freeze.

annotation.selection: Measured outcomes from the first result table, then abstract/result prose, with documented fallbacks. Exclude IDs, dates, citations, graph ticks and method constants. Preserve complete compound/scientific values.
annotation.independent_positions: PDFium original glyph/font boxes and rendered pages; original OOXML part, paragraph and character offsets. Never use PaperDelta candidate positions as gold.
annotation.zero_target_policy: Retain zero-target originals and count unfilled planned slots separately, never as supported or fabricated unknown targets.
annotation.annotator: Developer-operated annotation and visual checks; not independent human review.

evaluation.supported: Unique correct original position plus an explicit binding that passes controlled synthetic evidence and mismatches after changing it.
evaluation.prior_studies: Re-runs of native-v1/native-v2 are separate observed-input regressions; their originals, gold and results remain byte-identical.

annotation_export_acceptance.word: Anchored comments in a new DOCX copy; preserve text, formatting and existing relationships/comments. Unsupported original parts require explicit abstention.
annotation_export_acceptance.pdf: Highlights and notes in a new PDF copy at validated original page coordinates; preserve content and geometry.
annotation_export_acceptance.visual_checks: Render produced copies and original pages; verify positions, clipping and text preservation.
